en: Captain! We have reached the\ntarget sector.
...Do you see anything\ndangerous in the vicinity?
I cannot confirm the presence\nof any other spacecraft in this\nsector.
For now, I believe we can\nconsider it safe, wouldn't you\nsay?
Hmm, it is strange if you think\nabout it, but reassuring at the\nsame time.
Of course, I will remain vigilant!
More importantly, right now...
Yes, you're right. Tika.
Yeah.
Is that your planet?
...Yeah, that's the one.
That's the planet where I was\nborn. Daftine.
Coro. Coro! Where are you?
Captain, do you know where\nCoro is?
Nyah? In a place like this...\nHey, Coro! Coro! Coro!!
Coro? If you don't wake up, I'm\ngoing to analyze all your secret\ndata!
Awawawawa!? V-Verda!? Did\nyou just say something\nabsolutely terrible!?
Nyahfufu? Hmm, did I say\nsomething? I don't recall. You\nmust have been dreaming!
P-please don't make it sound\nlike I was just napping!
Even if I look like I'm asleep, I\nam the Federation's latest AI!
I am programmed to ensure\nthat all various functions\nmaintain full performance...
Coro! You were totally napping!\nThe lights in the women's\nquarters went out!
You've gotten way too relaxed\nsince we left Planet Viret!
Eh, ah, I-I'm sorry!!
Hmm? Ah, there was\nsomething I wanted to check.

Captain, Coro, we are approaching that
particular sector soon. I was worried
whether the evasion route had been
established yet.
That particular sector?
What was it again?
...Coro, you really are\nsomething else...
*Sigh* It can't be helped. I wish\nEve would just listen...

<font color=blue>Verda</font> There is a bit of a
troublesome sector of space
ahead. If possible, it would be
best to avoid it.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> What do you mean? Is\nthere something dangerous\nthere?
<font color=blue>Verda</font> It is dangerous, but we\ndo not know exactly what the\ndanger is.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> What?

<font color=blue>Verda</font> Further ahead, there
was a planet where the Eldram
regime attempted to construct
a Pulse Tower.

However, the Levarance fleet led by
Eldram was attacked in that sector by
a mysterious advanced planetary force
and was forced to retreat.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> You mean the Levarance\nfleet actually fought and lost?

<font color=blue>Verda</font> Indeed. While no ships were
completely sunk, it seems they suffered
a one-sided defeat without ever
discovering the enemy's identity.

We have only one ship. If there is an
opponent capable of crippling an entire
fleet, I doubt we would survive a similar
encounter.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> Let's run! Let's get out of\nhere right now! Let's just take\na detour!

I mean, the only reason we're even on
this journey is because we were
chased by those mysterious space
pirates in the first place!
Well then, everyone, I'll start\nsearching for a new route, so\nfor a while...
Eh? W-what is this!?
W-what!? Could it be that\nmysterious advanced planetary\nforce?
We should not have reached\nthat sector yet!
Y-yes, that's right! No mistake\nabout it!
Is it an enemy!?

No, it's not an enemy, it's not an enemy,
but I mean, how is this even possible,
or rather, it'd be a problem if it were,
it's like a bolt from the blue, and with
Levarance and Viret...

I'm starting to wonder if there's a glitch
in the parts they fixed, which is
basically doubting someone's goodwill,
it's just so impossible that I don't even
know what to do anymore...
Calm down!!
Yes, ma'am!
What happened? Explain\nyourself calmly.
Y-yes, I apologize for losing my\ncomposure. I haven't detected\nany enemy forces.
It's just that... I detected\nsomething impossible, and it\nthrew me off.
Something impossible?
A distress signal!

Why on earth is a distress
signal impossible?! If you
detect one, you have to go
help immediately!
N-no, the thing is...
It's a Galactic Federation\ndistress signal!
Huh? W-what is this!?
It's a distress signal!
It's a Galactic Federation\ndistress signal!
What does that mean?

I don't understand it myself.
But there's no mistake, this is
a current Galactic Federation
signal.

But we're still in a sector far beyond
the Federation's sphere of influence.
There's no way a Federation ship
should be out here!
And the signal is coming from\nright near the sector Verda\nmentioned!
Does that mean someone from\nthe Levarance fleet was\ndefeated and is fleeing?
Yes! That's why I'm so\nconfused! This whole situation\nis just too irregular!
...Right. If we've received a\nFederation distress signal, we\nhave to go, don't we?

If it ever got out that we
ignored it, I'd be thrown in the
brig the moment I got back to
Earth.
All right, I'm going! I'm going!
Everyone, please fasten your\nharnesses! Activating the Warp\nDrive! Here we go!
Is that where the distress\nsignal is coming from?
I... I believe so... but it's\nstrange. It's not transmitting a\nsignal right now.
We can talk about that later!\nPriority one is recovery!
B-but what if it's some kind of\nexplosive?!

Your sensors aren't so useless
that they can't detect
explosives in a tiny escape
pod!
Stop complaining and just\nretrieve it! Now!
A-alright, I get it! Honestly, it's\nimpossible to tell who the\ncaptain is at this rate!
Hurry up and open the pod! We\nhave to save whoever is\ninside...!
Please wait! I have to enter a\nsafety confirmation code into\nthe pod first.

Also, I need to verify if the
occupant is a human
compatible with the ship's
atmosphere...

Atmospheric compatibility
confirmed. Awaiting safety
confirmation code
authentication.
...So it seems.
U-um... I see.

Now then, the safety confirmation
code... I think I can apply Levarance's
language algorithm. Let's see... here we
go.

Safety confirmation code
authenticated. Please clear the area
around the rescue vessel. Please clear
the area around the rescue vessel.
Hatch opening.
A girl...?
Is this child alone? That voice\nfrom before...
I am the AI of the escape pod\nfrom the transport ship Kugo.

I request that your vessel provide
protection for the pod's passenger,
<font color=yellow>Tika Blanche</font>. I request that your vessel
provide protection for the pod's
passenger, Tika Blanche.
Tika Blanche? Is that this girl's\nname?
It appears so.
Um, Mr. AI? This vessel is\nGFSS-3214F, belonging to the\nGalactic Federation.

In accordance with Galactic
Federation regulations, we will
initiate the protection program
for Tika Blanche.

I leave her in your care. Her
vitals are normal, but she
shows signs of mental
exhaustion.
We'll move her to the medical\nroom immediately! Verda,\nplease help!
Leave it to me!

<font color=blue>Coro</font> Something is definitely wrong.
There is no planet called "Daftine"
among the Federation member worlds,
and...

Why would a ship equipped with a
language program that can only be
analyzed by Levarance language
algorithms...
...be transmitting a Galactic\nFederation distress signal?

<font color=blue>Verda</font> She seems to be a girl much
younger than I am. Even if she regains
consciousness, it may be difficult to
question her about the reason.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Where is this "Daftine"\nplace the life pod's AI was\ntalking about?

<font color=blue>Coro</font> I really don't want to say this, but
the coordinates for Daftine are right in
the middle of the sector where the
Levarance fleet suffered that terrible
fate.
Do... do we really have to go\nthere?
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Of course we do! We have\nto get this child... we have to\nget Tika home!

<font color=blue>Coro</font> B-but the Levarance military fleet
is retreating! If we go in and end up
getting sunk just like them, we'll lose
everything...

<font color=blue>Verda</font> Then shall we just leave
her to be carried away into the
depths of space? I suppose
that is not an option.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> ...You're right. We have to\ngo. I guess we have no choice.

I'll set a course for Daftine, but
we aren't entering that sector
until Tika wakes up and we've
finished questioning her.
While we're at it, I should also\nquestion the AI from that\nescape pod...
Huh?

???: I am grateful to you for protecting
the crew member Tika Blanche. I have
come to provide an explanation to the
officer in charge of your vessel.
W-what is that... am I seeing\nthings?
Why is there another Coro...?\nAnd it's strangely tiny.
Are you by any chance the AI\nfrom the escape pod?

AI-056: Affirmative. I am the AI
of Escape Pod 56, deployed
from the transport ship Kugo:
RESCUE-AI-056.
AI-056! Whoa! Does that mean\nyou're called Coro too!?
Leesh & Verda: What?
I mean, if you're also called\nCoro, then that exterior makes\ntotal sense!
Huh? Is that how this works?

AI-056: I replicated an exterior
that would blend in with your
vessel, using the exterior of
your AI, Coro, as a reference.

AI-056: I leave the naming to you, but
to avoid confusion with your ship's AI,
Coro, I would like you to call me by a
different name.
I see... In that case, taking from\n"rescue," "zero," and\n"replicate"...
How about <font color=yellow>Rekoro</font>!
Accepted. I will register\n"Rekoro" as my individual name\nfrom this point forward.
Is there a problem?
No, it's fine... it's fine, but...
I just wonder why you had to\nuse that as a reference of all\nthings...
Was there really nothing else\nyou could have used for\nreference...?
Gosh, Rekoro is a wonderful AI!

See! Those who know, know! They
recognize the true value of my
interface, which is overflowing with
functional beauty!!
It would be difficult to say that\nthe exterior of your ship's AI,\nCoro, is highly functional.

However, I determined that it would be
effective in visually demonstrating that
I have no intention of rebelling against
your ship or its AI, Coro.
If Tika Blanche's condition is\nstable, I would like to explain\nthe situation.
...That's so mean...
I guess some people just\nappreciate true value, huh?
That's so mean!!!
<font color=blue>Verda</font> I see. So the colony ship\nwas attacked and sunk.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Do you think it was the\nwork of those people who\ndrove off the Levarance army?

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> Negative. I have determined
that whoever attacked the Kugo, the
ship carrying this vessel, does not
belong to any known advanced
planetary power.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> Isn't there any footage\nleft?

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> I found nothing
suspicious in the video records
I examined while we were
adrift.

I suspect that the direction this vessel
escaped was such that we could not
capture the attackers of the transport
ship.

<font color=blue>Verda</font> ...Regardless, it's a stroke of luck
that we were able to save this girl,
Tika... but it's a bit strange that there
are no other lifeboats in the area.

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> Agreed. Tika Blanche boarded
the colony ship with her family. I have
been unable to detect the lifeboat
carrying her family.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Hmm... once Tika wakes\nup, we may have to tell her\nsome painful truths.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> It's not decided yet!\nRekoro, why was Tika's family\non the colony ship?

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> From what I gathered while we
were adrift, Tika seemed to think of it
as nothing more than a large-scale
move.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Meaning there was no\nreason for the colony ship to\nbe attacked by anyone.
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> I am an AI that activates only\nduring emergencies. Therefore, I cannot\naccurately judge the political situation.

However, I can state with certainty that
there was no imminent crisis or volatile
tension with neighboring planetary
governments.
It's all a mystery... At any rate,\nfor now, we can only wait for\nTika to wake up...
Hm?
Ugh...
Ugh... where am I?
You must not get up yet. Rest\na while longer.
Who are you ladies? Where am\nI?
Tika. You are inside the vessel\nthat rescued us. You are now\nunder our protection.
That voice... AI? You're the AI\nfrom the escape pod, right?\nWhere are you?
I am here.
...AI... what happened to your\nappearance? You look strange.
There is a reason for this...
It's teeeerrible!!
Kyaah!?

It's not strange, it's wonderful! Rekoro's
current form is an imitation of me, an
interface overflowing with functional
beauty!

I'm reputed to be
"creepy-cute," so please don't
make a face the moment you
see me! It hurts my feelings!
I-I'm sorry...
Coro! You're scaring Tika! Sit!!
Aaaah!!
Sorry for startling you. He's a\nbit eccentric, but he's our\nship's AI. He's not a bad guy!
More importantly, this is our\ncaptain!
N-nice to meet you. Thank you\nfor saving me.

Also, your escape pod AI is
now calling himself Rekoro, and
he's come out like this to
protect you.
From now on, why don't you\ncall it Rekoro?
That is correct.
I understand. Thank you, Mr.\nAI...
Rekoro.
No need for thanks, Tika.
No, thank you, Rekoro!

Now then, if Tika has calmed
down, may I perform a brief
medical check and register her
as a crew member?
Yes, please.
Right this way, then.

Whether we're hearing her
story or explaining things, it'll
have to wait until after the
medical check.
Indeed. We shall wait for now.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> Tika's medical check and\ncrew registration for this ship\nare complete!
<font color=blue>Tika</font> Thank you, Coro.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Good work, Tika. I'm glad\nto see you're in good health.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> Yeah, it's all thanks to\neveryone finding me. Thank\nyou.

<font color=blue>Eve</font> Now then, Captain. Since
things have turned out this
way, our next destination is
pretty much decided, isn't it?
<font color=blue>Coro</font> Does that mean... we're\nheading to Daftine?
<font color=blue>Tika</font> What?
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Exactly. Where else would\nwe go?
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Now hold on, Eve. There\nis no need to rush.

<font color=blue>Verda</font> Tika, this may be difficult to
recall, but do you remember when you
escaped from that transport ship,
Kugo?
<font color=blue>Tika</font> ...Not really.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Did you see or hear\nanything about what the\nattackers were like?
<font color=blue>Tika</font> ...No.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> So it wasn't some\nrandom warship...
<font color=blue>Tika</font> I don't know... But I don't\nthink it was a warship...

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> The transport ship
Kugo was accompanied by
escort ships from the Daftine
army.

If someone had attacked, they
would have had to destroy
military vessels. That is not a
realistic assumption.

<font color=blue>Verda</font> Rekoro. For certain reasons, we
have received information that a
mysterious advanced planetary force
near Daftine has been

indiscriminately eliminating any
vessels entering the sector.
Could that force be the Daftine
army?

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> I cannot make a
definitive conclusion as this
ship's AI lacks the relevant
data.
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> However, the Daftine army is a\ndisciplined military force controlled by a\ndemocratic planetary government.

Even in the event of a territorial
violation, launching indiscriminate
attacks would be a violation of military
regulations.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> ...So you're saying we\nwon't know until we go there.

Come to think of it, Rekoro is
the AI of a life pod; it's not like
it's packed with military
secrets and data like Coro is.

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> Affirmative. The primary
objective of this vessel's AI, Rekoro, is
the life support of the passengers; all
functions are allocated toward that
end.

<font color=blue>Eve</font> But if what Rekoro says is
true, that means we won't be
attacked the moment we
arrive, right?

Maybe the Levarance army was
attacked because their goal of building
the Pulse Tower was perceived as an
invasion?
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Hmm, I suppose you\ncould put it that way.
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> Levarance army.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Hmm?

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> Planet Levarance is
registered as one of the
available evacuation
destinations for this vessel.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Well, it is close by. That\nmakes sense.
Anyway, it seems the decision\nhas been made.
...Sigh... I figured as much.
You're really taking me back to\nDaftine?!

Thank you! While we were
drifting through space, Rekoro
kept encouraging me, but I was
still so scared...

I started thinking that my grandpa was
right and that we should have never
tried to emigrate... I was just so
scared...
...Tika. ...Thy grandfather is\nback in thy homeland, is he\nnot?

Yeah... I had been fighting with my
parents, telling them that no matter
what happens, you should never
abandon the planet where you were
born... and then...
It isn't that far from here to\nDaftine. There is still much I do\nnot understand.
But I promise I will get you\nback to your grandfather. Do\nnot worry.
Thank you!
I am Evelysse. Please, call me\nEve.
I am Verda Kleiman.
Please call me Coro.
Thank you! Eve, Verda, Coro!\nAnd Captain <player>!
You're welcome!
Rekoro! This means I can finally\ngo home!
Tika, there is an important fact\nI must convey to you.
What is it?
Rekoro, does that really have\nto be said right now...?!
Negative. Delaying the\ndisclosure of facts is not\nadvisable.
Tika, please listen calmly. We\nare the only ones who were\nrescued by GFSS-3214F.
What...?
But Rekoro... I was escaping\nfrom Kugo with my family...

Tika, unfortunately, it is the
truth. We are the only ones
rescued by this ship; no other
lifeboats have been found.
No...
My father, my mother... no... is\nthere really no way to contact\nmy brother?!
Tika has been staring out the\nBridge windows ever since...

It's only natural. She doesn't
know where her family is. In
this situation, there's a high
chance they've passed away.
Captain, you said you were\ngoing, but maybe we should\njust leave her alone for now...!
Oh, Captain... Rekoro too...
You said there might still be\nhope... what do you mean by\nthat?
Tika. You and this vessel are in\na somewhat peculiar situation.
Two illogical events have\noccurred since the time this\nvessel was rescued.

First, we are unable to detect any
wreckage from the transport ship Kugo,
any lifeboats of the same model as this
one, or any military escort ships in the
surrounding space.
What does that mean?

Exactly what I said. Based on
my records, at least five
hundred lifeboats escaped
from the Kugo.
It is unlikely that every single\none of them was shot down.

And if they were, we should be
intercepting communications
from the black boxes that
transmit distress signals.
However, there are no such\nsignals at all.
And the next point is the most\nproblematic.

There has been absolutely no
response to any
communications sent to our
home planet, Daftine.

They aren't responding to
distress signals or any other
form of communication. It is
impossible.
Is it possible that some of your\nfunctions are damaged,\nRekoro?

According to my
self-diagnostics, there is no
damage or dysfunction
detected within this vessel.
Then we have no choice but to\ngo see for ourselves! To\nDaftine!

Tika, your family and the
others in the escape pods
might have already made it
back to Daftine.
All right, all right, I get it.

Based on Rekoro's escape pod
data, it should only take about
30 minutes to reach Daftine
via warp.

But we can't ignore the
damage to the Levarance army
that Verda mentioned. Let's
proceed with extreme caution!
I appreciate that.
Thank you, everyone, Captain!
Captain! We have reached the\ntarget sector.
...Do you see anything\ndangerous in the vicinity?

I cannot confirm the presence
of any other spacecraft in this
sector. For now, I believe we
can consider it safe.
Hmm, it is strange if you think\nabout it, but reassuring at the\nsame time.
Of course, we'll stay vigilant!\nBut for now...
Yes, that's right. Tika.
Tika: Yeah.
Is that your planet?
...Yes, that's it. That's the\nplanet where I was born.\nDaftine.
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> ...?
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Rekoro? What is the\nmatter?
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> This is strange...
<font color=blue>Coro</font> Yes, it is very strange.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> What's wrong?
<font color=blue>Coro</font> Tika, Rekoro. Is this really\nDaftine? Your home, Tika?
<font color=blue>Tika</font> Huh? Yeah. It is, but...
<font color=blue>Coro</font> Hmm, that shouldn't be\npossible...
<font color=blue>Verda</font> What do you mean?\nSpeak plainly!

<font color=blue>Coro</font> Right. According to the long-range
sensors, the civilization level of Planet
Daftine is, at the most generous
estimate, equivalent to Earth's 16th or
17th century.
It doesn't look like a planet\nthat possesses the technology\nto build starships.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> What?

<font color=blue>Coro</font> As Rekoro probably
noticed, we can't detect any
signals that resemble
communication waves at all.

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> Coro. This is Tika's registration
information from when she boarded the
transport ship Kugo, and it records her
place of residence.
Is it possible to scan that\nspecific location?

<font color=blue>Coro</font> Yes, let me see... Hmm,
these coordinates are right
here. I'll put them on the
monitor.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> ...Are you sure about this?

<font color=blue>Coro</font> I'm certain. There are a few spots
that look like mines, but otherwise,
there are only scattered villages
without even basic internal combustion
engines.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> ...
<font color=blue>Verda</font> This is far beyond the\nissue of whether they can build\na starship...
<font color=blue>Coro</font> But every piece of\ninformation we received from\nRekoro points to this planet.
I don't think Tika is lying, so\nhonestly, I don't know how to\njudge this...

<font color=blue>Eve</font> Exactly! If we don't
understand, we just have to go
see for ourselves! That's our
Captain for you!
<font color=blue>Coro</font> What!? Captain, are you\nactually serious!?

No matter how you look at it, this is an
undeveloped planet. It's protected
under the Undeveloped Planet
Protection Treaty!
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Well, there's nothing else\nwe can do besides beaming\ndown to gather information.

You said it yourself. The
information from Tika and
Rekoro pointed toward this
planet.
Now, all that's left is to get\nsome boots on the ground.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> W-well, that's true, but...

<font color=blue>Verda</font> We cannot simply take
Tika and Rekoro away as they
are, can we? If so, there is
only one course of action!

<font color=blue>Eve</font> We solve this strange mystery
ourselves and return Tika and the
others to their grandfather. There's no
other way!
<font color=blue>Tika</font> Big sister Eve... Big sister\nVerda...

<font color=blue>Coro</font> Ugh, I feel like I'm always
being pushed around... But
what exactly are we going to
do once we land?

<font color=blue>Verda</font> Hmm, for example, we
could collect genetic
information from the local
inhabitants.

With just a single strand of hair, we can
analyze it and compare it to Tika's
genes. We'll know soon enough if Tika is
originally from this planet.
Can I go down there too?

I object. As the life pod's AI, I
cannot approve of placing Tika
in an irregular environment
while she is aboard this vessel.
...I'm sorry, Rekoro.
But I want to go.
Eve: Tika...
Everyone is working so hard to\nfind out what happened to\nDaftine for my sake...
I don't think I should just leave\neverything to everyone else.
I think I should go down there\nand help too.
...She's starting to sound a lot\nlike Eve.
Is it okay, Captain?!
Eve: You're right! No matter\nwhat happens, Coro can just\nteleport us back, right?

Eve: We can travel the planet
much more safely now than we
could before we reached
Levarance!

It's settled then. Coro, keep a constant
trace on us and retrieve us immediately
if you judge the situation to be
dangerous.
Yes, yes, yes! I got it, I got it!
...Still.
Rekoro, if you're that worried,\nhow about this?
What is it?
A Power Arm for self-defense,\ndesigned so even a frail child\ncan use it.

It has a built-in automatic
defense system, making it
useful for combat, protection,
and various other tasks.

I originally made this for myself,
but since Tika and I are about
the same size, it should fit her
perfectly.
Wow! I want to try it! It looks\nlike fun!
Right!? Isn't it!? Isn't it cool!?
Hmm.

Don't worry, Rekoro. Of course
we'll do our best to protect
Tika and keep her out of
danger.
Think of that as just a backup\nplan, just in case.

If you'd like, I could link Tika's Arms
with Rekoro. There is still room for
improvement in the automatic defense
mechanisms.
Since Rekoro is already in that\nbody,

I suggest they descend together and
link with the Arms' computer. That way,
Rekoro can cover the blind spots Tika
might miss.
Rekoro...
Under those conditions, I agree\nto Tika's descent.
Thank you, Rekoro!
All right! Now that it's settled,\nlet's go, Tika!!
Huh, wait!
Tika!?
Don't worry. We'll leave Tika's\nArms in Verda's hands.
